articles.title: GHSA: OpenTelemetry Java Instrumentation: JDBC Auto-Instrumentation Logging Clear-Text Passwords
articles.summary: OpenTelemetry Java Instrumentation JDBC auto-instrumentation may fail to sanitize passwords in SQL CONNECT statements when the password is double-quoted. As a result, clear-text database passwords can be added to trace span attributes and exported to observability backends.

articles.title: GHSA: Easy!Appointments appointments/store and appointments/update allow cross-provider appointment injection — Authorization Bypass
articles.summary:
## Summary
 
Easy!Appointments correctly filters provider-scoped appointments in the `appointments/search` response, proving that provider isolation is an intended security boundary.
